FUNDER OVERVIEW
[Funder Name] is a private family foundation. It makes about 40 grants a year, almost all in Texas, and Catholic education is its first priority. RESEARCH-FINDINGS-MARKER
Source: https://example.org/funder/about

PAST GRANTS
- [Other School Name] | 2024 | $15,000 | K-3 reading intervention materials | https://example.org/funder/annual-report-2024
- [Parish Name] Food Pantry | 2023 | $8,000 | Weekend meal bags for students | https://example.org/funder/990pf-2023.pdf
- [Third School Name] | 2023 | $25,000 | Science lab renovation | https://example.org/funder/990pf-2023.pdf

PRIORITIES AND PATTERNS
Catholic elementary education in Texas, early literacy and tuition assistance. Most grants are $5,000 to $25,000 (https://example.org/funder/annual-report-2024).

EXCLUSIONS AND PROCESS
No grants to individuals or for endowments. A letter of inquiry comes first; one request every 12 months.
